description: File-level provenance for HVAC BESTEST (RP-865) comparative reference bounds. Each entry binds a data file to its primary publication, the reference programs that generated the bounds, and the units the values are recorded in. Tabular rows in each CSV carry their own per-record provenance; this manifest records the document-level authority.

nrel_rp865.citation: Neymark, J.; Judkoff, R.; Knabe, G.; Le, H. "Airside HVAC BESTEST: Adaptation of ASHRAE RP 865 Airside HVAC Equipment Modeling Test Cases for ASHRAE Standard 140, Volume 1: Cases AE101-AE445." NREL/TP-5500-66000, National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Golden, CO (2016).

iea_task22_e100.citation: IEA SHC Task 22. "HVAC BESTEST, Volume 1: Cases E100-E200, Unitary Space Cooling Equipment." Building Energy Analysis Tools, International Energy Agency Solar Heating and Cooling Programme.

files.notes: Unitary space-cooling equipment comparative bounds. CE100-CE140 dry-coil, CE150-CE200 wet-coil. Case IDs renamed from the original Task 22 E100-E200 to the 140-2023 CE100-CE200 identifiers (same cases; #4296). Values are the qualified-program ensemble (min/max) ranges reported in the source.
RP-865 airside HVAC equipment comparative bounds. Values are the qualified-program ensemble (min/max) ranges reported in NREL/TP-5500-66000.

status_legend.published: Value taken directly from the cited publication's tabulated results.
status_legend.transcribed: Value transcribed from the cited publication; flagged for independent re-verification against the primary PDF.
status_legend.interim: Derived value pending replacement by a direct reference-program run; methodology documented in the source.
